preset: 08 Games - Stars in Shadow (4X Strategy/2D Sprite)
style: Palette of periwinkle blue, dawn rose pink and warm starlight cream over deep indigo night.

images.prompt: Wide side-view landscape filling the whole frame edge to edge: a small person in a cream and periwinkle work jumpsuit with a small backpack stands on a grassy hilltop of a small planet whose curved horizon is clearly visible, looking up at the dawn sky. Above, an enormous long rounded carrier starship with cream hull plating and periwinkle stripes hangs in the sky, and a stubby boxy dropship flies up toward its glowing hangar bay. A huge soft glowing star rises at the horizon, other planets and moons hang in the sky as round discs, with a nebula and distant galaxies beyond. Below the hill sits a cozy homestead with a garden and a parked chunky six-wheeled rover. A feeling of boundless freedom on a calm morning. Keep the lower left of the image calm and uncluttered. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

Side-view cross-section of a world filling the entire wide frame, like a game screenshot cutaway: on the surface a cozy homestead with a vegetable garden and a greenhouse dome; below the ground, layered rock strata in different colours with a dug tunnel where a person in a cream and periwinkle work jumpsuit digs with a handheld tool, small stacked piles of sorted materials beside the tunnel; to the right a chunky six-wheeled rover drives up the rear ramp of a landed stubby boxy dropship; high in the sky an enormous long carrier starship with cream hull plating and periwinkle stripes. One continuous scene from underground up to orbit, warm daylight, tiny people going about their lives. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

Side-view cutaway of an enormous long carrier starship in orbit above a planet's curved horizon, its cream hull with periwinkle stripes cut open to show every deck: a bridge at the front with crew at consoles, crew quarters, a glowing reactor room, engines at the back, and a large hangar bay in the middle where a stubby boxy dropship is parked, and inside the dropship's own open cargo bay a chunky six-wheeled rover. Tiny people walk the decks standing upright on their floors. Stars and a soft glowing star beyond. A clean, readable cross-section like a technical cutaway illustration. No text, labels, lettering or signatures anywhere.

Tall portrait cover illustration: in the lower third, a small person in a cream and periwinkle work jumpsuit with a small backpack stands on a grassy cliff edge of a small planet, seen from behind, looking out. The upper two thirds are a vast dawn sky: a huge glowing star, several planets and moons as round discs, an enormous long rounded carrier starship with cream hull plating crossing the sky, tiny ships travelling between worlds, a sweeping nebula and distant galaxies, and far above, the faint curved glowing rim of the edge of the universe. Calm open sky at the very top. Inviting and full of wonder. No text, lettering, title or signatures anywhere.

Extremely wide zoomed-out cosmic vista: a calm, flat, luminous plane of countless spiral galaxies and star clusters stretching away to the horizon, and all around its far edges a colossal curved wall of swirling multicoloured cosmic storms rising up like the rim of a bowl: the edge of the universe. In the lower foreground, seen at an angle, a soft glowing star with a few green-continented planets scattered loosely near it, a ring-shaped space station and tiny ships flying between them, like a painting rather than a map. Serene, vast and optimistic. No orbit lines, no diagram, no labels. No text, lettering, names or signatures anywhere.
